title: Look, Think, Act = Sync, Reason, Act
html:
Look, Think, Act = Sync, Reason, Act

Choose among what’s offered. The only place a model sits, and a kept script can stand in for it.

Act

Send the form: method, target, fields, If-Match, signed.

Think is the only step that costs tokens. Look and Act read and send controls the server handed over: free on every replay.

“Typed relations, specific media types, and action-specific elements provide the guidance needed for automated agents.”

Roy T. Fielding, comment, 2008 ·
say: A person in a browser and ARTIE run the same loop. Sync and Act are plain code. Reason is the only place a model sits, and a kept script can stand in for it on every later run. Think is the only step that costs tokens: Hightower's budget, spent once. Look and Act are Fielding's controls, read for free.
